commands.description: Generate credential report for account hygiene
commands.command: aws iam generate-credential-report && sleep 5 && aws iam get-credential-report --query Content --output text | base64 -d
az ad user list --filter "accountEnabled eq false" --query "[].userPrincipalName" --output tsv

commands.description: List MFA devices for all users
commands.command: for user in $(aws iam list-users --query "Users[].UserName" --output text); do echo "=== $user ==="; aws iam list-mfa-devices --user-name "$user" --output table; done
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::<account>:user/<username> --action-names s3:GetObject s3:PutObject --output table
az role assignment list --all --role Owner --output table
gcloud projects get-iam-policy <project-id> --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role | contains("admin") or contains("owner"))'

commands.description: List roles with session duration limits
Check role trust policies for time-bounded conditions
List app assignments with time-bounded access
List all access keys and age
Check credential expiry for service principals
commands.command: az ad sp credential list --id <appId> --query "[].{KeyId:keyId,Type:type,EndDate:endDateTime}" --output table

commands.description: List service account keys and age
Search for failed login attempts in last 24h
commands.command: splunk search 'index=main sourcetype=access_combined action=failure | stats count by src_ip user | sort -count | head 20' -earliest -24h
splunk search 'index=main action=failure | stats count by user src_ip | where count > 10 | sort -count' -earliest -1h

commands.description: Look up recent unauthorized API calls
Show details of an IAM resource
Get compliance summary by config rules
Diff live state against desired manifests
Test Terraform files for best practices
Get compliance status for all rules
List security assessments and their status
List security groups with open ingress

commands.description: Find NSG rules allowing any source
commands.command: az network nsg rule list --nsg-name <nsg-name> --resource-group <rg> --query "[?sourceAddressPrefix=='*'].{Name:name,Direction:direction,Access:access,Port:destinationPortRange}" --output table

for ns in $(kubectl get ns -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'); do count=$(kubectl get networkpolicy -n "$ns" --no-headers 2>/dev/null | wc -l); [ "$count" -eq 0 ] && echo "No NetworkPolicy: $ns"; done

commands.description: List load balancers and their AZs
List NSG rules in a security group
commands.command: az network nsg rule list --nsg-name <nsg-name> --resource-group <rg> --query "[].{Name:name,Priority:priority,Direction:direction,Access:access,Source:sourceAddressPrefix,DestPort:destinationPortRange}" --output table
az network front-door waf-policy list --query "[].{Name:name,Mode:policySettings.mode,State:policySettings.enabledState}" --output table
az network vnet list --query "[].{Name:name,RG:resourceGroup,AddressSpace:addressSpace.addressPrefixes[0],Subnets:subnets | length(@)}" --output table
gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits --jq '.[].{sha: .sha[:7], message: .commit.message, author: .commit.author.name, date: .commit.author.date}' | head -20

commands.description: Show current state with resource details

commands.command: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments --jq '.[].{id: .id, env: .environment, ref: .ref, created: .created_at}' | head -10
argocd app get <app-name> --output json | jq '{status: .status.sync.status, health: .status.health.status}'

commands.description: Check required status checks for a commit
Check rollout status of a deployment
List log groups and retention settings

commands.command: splunk search 'index=_audit action=search info=granted | stats count by user info | sort -count' -earliest -7d
splunk search '| rest /services/authorization/roles | table title srchIndexesAllowed srchIndexesDefault'
az monitor log-analytics workspace list --query "[].{Name:name,RG:resourceGroup,Retention:retentionInDays,Sku:sku.name}" --output table

commands.description: List all config rules and compliance
Get compliance summary by resource type
List event types in recent logs
commands.command: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --max-results 50 --query "Events[].EventName" --output text | tr '\t' '\n' | sort -u

commands.description: List diagnostic settings for a resource
List indexed sourcetypes with event counts
commands.command: splunk search 'index=main | stats count by sourcetype | sort -count' -earliest -24h

commands.description: Check log ingestion volume by source
commands.command: splunk search 'index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=per_sourcetype_thruput | stats sum(kb) as totalKB by series | sort -totalKB' -earliest -24h

commands.description: Check SIEM health and indexing status
commands.command: splunk search 'index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=pipeline | stats sum(cpu_seconds) as cpu by name | sort -cpu' -earliest -1h
splunk search '| rest /servicesNS/-/-/saved/searches | search is_scheduled=1 alert_type!="" | table title eai:acl.app cron_schedule disabled'

commands.description: List active monitors and their status

commands.command: splunk search 'index=main sourcetype=syslog OR sourcetype=wineventlog | stats count by sourcetype host | sort -count' -earliest -24h
splunk search 'index=main tag=authentication | stats count by action user src | sort -count | head 50' -earliest -24h

aws logs start-query --log-group-name <group> --start-time $(date -v-24H +%s) --end-time $(date +%s) --query-string 'fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /ERROR/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50'
az monitor log-analytics query --workspace <workspace-id> --analytics-query "SecurityEvent | summarize count() by EventID, Activity | top 20 by count_"

commands.description: Get compliance status per resource type
Check for drift with exit code

commands.command: kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.status.containerStatuses[]?.state.waiting?.reason=="CrashLoopBackOff") | {ns: .metadata.namespace, name: .metadata.name}'

for bucket in $(aws s3api list-buckets --query "Buckets[].Name" --output text); do aws s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket "$bucket" 2>&1 | grep -q NoSuchLifecycleConfiguration && echo "No lifecycle: $bucket"; done

commands.description: Show storage account lifecycle management policy
commands.command: az storage account management-policy show --account-name <account> --resource-group <rg> --output json

commands.description: List persistent volumes and reclaim policies

commands.command: az network application-gateway ssl-cert list --gateway-name <gw-name> --resource-group <rg> --query "[].{Name:name}" --output table
kubectl get ingress --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | {ns: .metadata.namespace, name: .metadata.name, tls: .spec.tls}'
gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/alerts --jq '.[].{package: .security_advisory.summary, severity: .security_advisory.severity, state: .state}' | head -20
snyk test --json | jq '{vulns: .vulnerabilities | length, high: [.vulnerabilities[] | select(.severity=="high")] | length}'
gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/alerts --jq '.[].{package: .dependency.package.name, ecosystem: .dependency.package.ecosystem, severity: .security_advisory.severity, state: .state}' | head -20
npm audit --json | jq '{total: .metadata.vulnerabilities | add, critical: .metadata.vulnerabilities.critical, high: .metadata.vulnerabilities.high}'
gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependency-graph/compare/main...HEAD --jq '.[].{change,manifest,package_url,vulnerabilities}' 2>/dev/null || echo "Use on PR branches"
npm audit --json | jq '.vulnerabilities | to_entries[] | {package: .key, severity: .value.severity, fixAvailable: .value.fixAvailable}'

commands.description: List all resources grouped by type
commands.command: az resource list --query "[].type" --output tsv | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones --jq '.[].{title, progress: ((.closed_issues / ((.open_issues + .closed_issues) | if . == 0 then 1 else . end)) * 100 | floor | tostring + "%")}'
jira issue list --project SECURITY --plain --columns status | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
gh issue list --label security --state all --json number,title,state,createdAt --limit 30

commands.description: Test for vulnerabilities in CI pipeline

commands.command: snyk test --json | jq '[.vulnerabilities[] | {id,title,severity,from}] | group_by(.severity) | map({severity: .[0].severity, count: length})'
gh issue list --label postmortem --state all --json number,title,state,createdAt --limit 20
pd incident list --status resolved --since "90 days ago" --output json | jq '.[] | {title,created_at,resolved_at,urgency}'
splunk search 'index=notable | stats count by rule_name status_label | sort -count' -earliest -90d
pd oncall list --output json | jq '.[] | {user: .user.summary, schedule: .schedule.summary, start: .start, end: .end}'

commands.description: List past incidents by date range
commands.command: pd incident list --status resolved --since "180 days ago" --output json | jq '.[] | {title,urgency,created_at,resolved_at}'
pd analytics incident list --since "90 days ago" --output json | jq '.[] | {description,seconds_to_resolve,urgency}'
splunk search 'index=notable status_label!="New" | stats count by rule_name urgency status_label | sort -count' -earliest -180d
gh issue list --label incident --state closed --json number,title,createdAt,closedAt --limit 20
